scope: Complete N3 metadata, including startup and memory/schedule closure; excludes fixture replay verification, native input generation, runtime preissue and recursive proof generation.

baseline.description: Exact completed optimization at start of this pass, including pending changes over main 6de9c01.

harness_adjustments.reason: Allow 2 and 4 workers in profiling guard and receipt parser only; Rust implementation unchanged.

pilot.description: Diagnostic prototype before segment sharding and paired native census jobs; excluded from final paired acceptance.

comparison_method.ordering: Pair order alternates with repetition and configuration; all processes run sequentially under the exclusive guard.
comparison_method.statistic: Median complete-stage seconds; ratio of medians defines elapsed reduction; paired median reductions and ranges also retained.

notes: Only the 140 final paired runs determine performance gates. All diagnostic samples are retained separately.
Descriptor request totals include explicit prewarming and merged worker hits; compare cold compilations and evictions rather than denominators alone.
Native census recordings are distinct from software descriptor-cache compiler misses.
Parallel worker_ns is summed elapsed task time, not OS CPU time; registration publication includes GPU preparation and overlaps hashes.
Native jobs are balanced groups of up to two descriptors. Their count is not the number of descriptors.
The serial selector disables new worker waves; previous paired registration remains enabled above one worker.
Documentation and this evidence were added after the frozen measured source snapshot.
